ios.desc:
Echu — Turn links into short, readable cards

Echu helps you actually learn from the content you save.
Turn articles, YouTube videos, PDFs, and EPUBs into short, readable cards you can review in minutes — not hours.
Whether it’s a deep-dive article, a saved documentary, or a long newsletter you’ll “read later”, Echu breaks it down into simple cards you can quickly understand and keep in your library.
